header.title: Power hour: Acquia’s accessibility solutions for regulated industries
header.description: Join us on 1/18 for an accessibility power hour!

flexible_post_content.text_editor:
In industries with strict rules and regulations, navigating accessibility standards and best practices can become even more complex.

Join O3 and Acquia for a power hour to discuss the ins and outs of Accessible digital experiences and how they specifically apply in regulated industries. Bring your questions and thoughts, as we’ll open up the floor after a short presentation.

Date:

1/18

Time:

12PM ET

Presenters:

Brian Crumley (UX Engineer), O3

Alison Voghel (Sr. UX Designer), Acquia

Watch the webinar recording here

Please reach out to Maddie Boucher with any questions or comments.
